claim_text: Short exercise sessions with low-to-moderate sweat loss do not by themselves establish a need for electrolyte supplementation; ordinary hydration and dietary intake are generally sufficient for many such sessions.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.

population.other_context: People undertaking short sessions with low-to-moderate sweat loss.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance materials provide context for sports products and exercise needs.
limitations: Individual conditions, heat, illness and unusual sweat losses may alter needs.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
